PRIMARY_BENCHMARK_METRICS.name: clean_success_rate
PRIMARY_BENCHMARK_METRICS.description: Proportion of episodes reaching destination terminus with zero safety violations.

PRIMARY_BENCHMARK_METRICS.name: safety_failure_rate
PRIMARY_BENCHMARK_METRICS.description: Proportion of episodes terminating due to any physical collision or road departure.

PRIMARY_BENCHMARK_METRICS.name: mean_final_route_completion
PRIMARY_BENCHMARK_METRICS.description: Mean fraction of global route completed at episode termination.

PRIMARY_BENCHMARK_METRICS.name: median_final_route_completion
PRIMARY_BENCHMARK_METRICS.description: Median fraction of global route completed (robust to outlier early crashes).

PRIMARY_BENCHMARK_METRICS.name: mean_time_to_clean_success_s
PRIMARY_BENCHMARK_METRICS.description: Mean simulation time in seconds to reach clean arrival, computed strictly over successful episodes (null if 0 successes).

SECONDARY_DIAGNOSTIC_METRICS.name: raw_arrival_rate
SECONDARY_DIAGNOSTIC_METRICS.description: Proportion of episodes crossing destination line, regardless of whether a collision occurred.

SECONDARY_DIAGNOSTIC_METRICS.name: timeout_rate
SECONDARY_DIAGNOSTIC_METRICS.description: Proportion of episodes truncated by step budget exhaustion.

SECONDARY_DIAGNOSTIC_METRICS.name: primary_outcome_rates
SECONDARY_DIAGNOSTIC_METRICS.description: Mutually exclusive rates for crash_human, crash_vehicle, crash_object, crash_building, crash_sidewalk, out_of_road.

SECONDARY_DIAGNOSTIC_METRICS.name: raw_safety_event_rates
SECONDARY_DIAGNOSTIC_METRICS.description: Individual event frequencies allowing overlapping/simultaneous events (crash_vehicle, crash_object, crash_building, crash_human, crash_sidewalk, out_of_road, any_safety_event).

SECONDARY_DIAGNOSTIC_METRICS.name: mean_max_route_completion
SECONDARY_DIAGNOSTIC_METRICS.description: Highest route completion attained during episode (surfaces backtracking behavior).

TRAINING_DIAGNOSTICS_ONLY.name: mean_episode_return
TRAINING_DIAGNOSTICS_ONLY.description: Mean cumulative RL reward return. Strictly classified as a training diagnostic; never used for benchmark ranking.
